messages:
alice: Heads-up: incoming DSAR for user user@example.com requesting deletion of all personal data across regions. They explicitly mention assistant chat history, search hits, and embeddings. Need to confirm cross-region propagation and KMS-backed snapshot deletion. cc @legal-team @dave

 dsar-bot: DSAR-431 created (ticket DSAR-431). Request received 2026-03-19T14:02:01Z.

 dave: Oncall — pinged. Which embedding index + model + which regions have replicas? Also any scheduled snapshots?

 alice: index_id: emb-dev-prod-2026-03, model: redwood-rlhf-7b, replicas: us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. Nightly snapshots land in s3://redwood-embeddings-backups (multi-region replication enabled).

 erin: Action plan suggestion: pause dsar-propagator to avoid concurrent writes, lock the index, run cross-region delete job, verify audit logs, then remove snapshots. If there are KMS denies we may need temporary key grants. Also consider a short retention-exception hold only if legal requests forensics — otherwise proceed.

 bob: Legal — do we need a retention exception or can security proceed with immediate deletion once requestor confirms?

 legal-team: No forensic hold requested. Proceed with deletion once we have written confirmation from the requester (email). We also require a pre-deletion audit bundle (immutable snapshot of relevant logs) for our records.

 dave: I'll create a sub-ticket and perform lock. Lock command I will run:

 ```bash
 kubectl exec -n platform dsar-propagator -- ./lock-index --id emb-dev-prod-2026-03 --reason=DSAR-431
 ```

 erin: Audit query to run for verification (run before and after):

 ```sql
 SELECT event_time, actor, action, resource_id, metadata FROM audit_logs
 WHERE resource_id='emb-dev-prod-2026-03'
 ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200;
 ```

 erin: And sample dsar-propagator log snippet (for debugging):

 ```text
 2026-03-19T13:04:21Z INFO  dsar-propagator starting propagation to eu-west-1
 2026-03-19T13:04:23Z ERROR dsar-propagator key-access-denied for kms-key: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
 2026-03-19T13:04:27Z INFO  dsar-propagator queued delete task for shard=12
 ```

 carol: If KMS denies, we have two options: 1) grant temporary kms-delete role to dsar-admin via STS with strict expiration, or 2) run deletion in the region from a VM with existing key access. I prefer 1) with short-lived creds so we have an auditable principal. Also ensure audit logs include kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion / kms:DeleteAlias events.

 bob: Who can approve temporary KMS grant? @carol (security) + @dave (infra)?

 alice: Yes, carol + dave can approve. Document approvals in DSAR-431. Also capture exact CMKs used so legal has proof.

 carol: I'll approve temporary key grant once legal confirms requestor email. After deletion I'll produce an audit bundle: s3://dsar-audit/DSAR-431/bundle.tar.gz containing:
 - audit_logs.csv
 - kms_events.csv
 - propagation_job.log
 - deletion_manifest.json

 dave: Plan outline (will follow exactly):
 1) pause dsar-propagator service
 2) lock index emb-dev-prod-2026-03
 3) create pre-deletion audit bundle
 4) run cross-region delete with kms-delete-role (us-east -> eu-west -> ap-northeast)
 5) verify deletes via audit log query + manifest
 6) delete S3 snapshots and mark replication targets removed
 7) rotate involved CMKs if any key material possibly exposed
 ETA: 2-4 hours after written requester confirmation.

 erin: RBAC note: temporarily revoke 'embed-admin' from all non-essential service accounts; grant 'dsar-admin' role to dsar-propagator and dsar-operator, expiration 6h. Use the following command to revoke:

 ```bash
 rbacctl grant dsar-admin --principal=service:dsar-propagator --expires-in=6h
 rbacctl revoke embed-admin --selector=service-account!=dsar-propagator
 ```

 bob: List of CMKs to track: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/aaaa-1111, arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111122223333:key/bbbb-2222, arn:aws:kms:ap-northeast-1:111122223333:key/cccc-3333

 alice: I'll email the requester and paste confirmation here. Also tagging legal + security to follow the audit bundle when ready.

 dsar-bot: DSAR-431 status: awaiting requester confirmation (email_sent).

 alice: Requester replied and confirmed at 14:05 UTC with matching email. Proceeding now.

 dave: Starting ops now. Will post progress updates to DSAR-431 thread.

 carol: Reminder: do not delete any global logs used for incident investigation. Only delete user-derived artifacts (embeddings, assistant chat transcripts, snapshots). Keep system-wide telemetry per retention policy.

 bob: Noted. I'll update DSAR ticket and close loop with legal once bundle uploaded.

 alice: Thanks team. Please paste final deletion_manifest.json and audit bundle link here when done. :thumbsup:
